knowledge_point.title: Determining the Dimension of the Product of Two Matrices Given the Dimensions of the Factors

question.:question/problem: Suppose $A$ is a $7 \times 1$ matrix and $B$ is a $1 \times 3$ matrix. What are the dimensions of $AB$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
There are $1$ columns in $A$ and $1$ rows in $B.$ Since the number of columns in $A$ equals the number of rows in $B,$ the matrices $A$ and $B$ are conformable for multiplication, and $AB$ is a $7\times 3$ matrix:

$$
{A}_{7\times \boxed{\text{1}}}{\times }_{✓}{B}_{\boxed{\text{1}}\times 3}={AB}_{7\times 3}
$$
